facets.F1_correctness: Adds an executable ERP hyperscaler parity matrix covering control-plane API, resource model, lifecycle operations, tenant isolation, IAM/authz, quota/capacity, billing/metering, audit trail, observability/SLOs, regional residency, backup/restore, security, compliance, SDK/API ergonomics, and runbooks.
facets.F2_tests: Buck2 parity test target now validates that every required hyperscaler facet is present, evidence-backed, repo-path-resolvable, and guarded by a gap-closure gate; a missing control-plane facet is rejected.
facets.F3_maintainability: The change stays in the existing tenant-rbac ERP parity-map crate and extends the current typed map/validation pattern without new dependencies or generated artifact edits.
facets.F4_compatibility: Existing ERP module rows, forbidden ERP-platform destination checks, capabilities schema version, and runtime/cloud non-claims remain intact. The matrix is exposed separately through erp_hyperscaler_parity_matrix().
facets.F5_security: No secrets, credentials, network calls, unsafe Rust, shell authority, or production service privileges are introduced. The matrix preserves provider-neutral composition and Cedar-backed authz references.
facets.F6_privacy: The matrix references public repository evidence only and does not process tenant, user, or personal data.
facets.F7_operability: Operational runbook, SLO, residency, rollback, and audit facets now have explicit tracked evidence so reviewers can see which gaps remain before ERP-wide promotion.
facets.F8_performance: The matrix is static Rust data validated with linear scans over 15 facets; no runtime hot path or data-plane service is affected.
facets.F9_compliance: SOX/compliance evidence remains explicit through ERP PRD, financial-planning manifest, DPIA, and audit-chain contract references.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of the additive Rust API, tests, and this evidence file. No migrations, generated faces, or production state are changed.
facets.F11_observability: The parity matrix includes observability/SLO and operational runbook facets as first-class review gates.
facets.F13_migration: Supports the owned-stack migration mandate by preventing ERP coverage from drifting into a monolithic ERP platform service or provider-specific runtime claim.

hyperscaler_lens.capability_matrix: All 15 requested hyperscaler parity facets are now represented by typed Rust data and test validation.
hyperscaler_lens.provider_neutrality: The matrix benchmarks AWS/GCP-class control-plane capabilities and ERP SaaS surfaces without binding the core map to a provider SDK.
hyperscaler_lens.separation_of_concerns: Domain/kernel evidence remains provider-agnostic; service contracts, Cedar policy, runbooks, SLOs, and IaC remain adapter or application-layer references.
hyperscaler_lens.merge_conflict_resistance: Only the ERP parity-map crate, its tests, and one unique evidence file are touched.

known_gaps: Remote oya-ci-required/cloud-ci status and reviewer approval remain pending until PR creation.
specs/multispectrum-review.json is absent in this checkout, so this file follows the existing 2.4.0-compatible evidence shape used under evidence/multispectrum.
.omx/ultragoal/goals.json and .omx/ultragoal/ledger.jsonl are not present in this worktree; final lane evidence will still name Ultragoal G015 per the orchestrator contract.
This slice establishes the verification gate; it does not claim live ERP runtime, cloud deployment, generated SDKs, or ERP-wide billing meters.

explicit_non_claims: No ERP platform microservice is created.
No production runtime, deployed listener, durable business document store, workflow execution, cloud deployment, or runtime audit-chain emission is claimed.
No generated JSON face is hand-edited.
scope.summary: Add an executable hyperscaler parity matrix and regression gate for ERP/SAP parity coverage.
